implemented: reconnectable eth_subscribe(newHeads) transport with provider failover and canonical backfill bridge
Redis Streams consumer-group distributed scan queue with 15-minute default XAUTOCLAIM recovery window and configurable reclaim timing
process-isolated scan runner with CPU/memory/wall-time limits
static-analysis command sandbox with POSIX rlimits and optional bubblewrap network isolation
bubblewrap project workspace mapping with explicit writable submounts and explicit host-network opt-in
multi-provider RPC routing with health, circuit breaking, capability-aware method fallback and provider evidence
deterministic mutation fuzzing with fork execution and trace coverage guidance
bounded EVM symbolic branch guidance with optional Z3 selector solving
optional Foundry fuzz and Halmos symbolic adapter using the same sandbox boundary
group-aware holdout FP/FN calibration with duplicate sample validation, Wilson intervals, Brier score and ECE
deep-scan, calibration, realtime and distributed-worker CLI entry points

runtime_requirements.distributed: pip install .[distributed] with Redis 6.2+ recommended for XAUTOCLAIM
runtime_requirements.deep: pip install .[deep]; Foundry/Halmos adapters also require host executables
runtime_requirements.production: pip install .[production] and provide host-level sandbox capability

remaining_data_or_host_gates: FP/FN production calibration requires a real, independently labeled corpus; no synthetic labels are promoted to production truth.
Bubblewrap network isolation is host-dependent and is explicitly reported when unavailable.
Foundry/Halmos execution is adapter-level and requires a project test harness; absence of the binaries returns unavailable.
Full EVM symbolic path proof remains outside the built-in bounded bytecode analyzer and requires a suitable harness/symbolic backend.
